text: The Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on April 4, 2018 adopted recommendations to amend the parking regulations on Sheridan Avenue, between Dundas Street West and College Street. Once adopted, and the necessary bills passed, parking would be permanently placed on the west side of Sheridan Avenue (Dundas Street West to College Street) Soon after this item was adopted, it was brought to my attention there had been an error in the recommendations. Therefore, the purpose of re-opening this item is to make the necessary corrections.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened item TE31.96 entitled "Parking Amendments on Sheridan Avenue, between Dundas Street West and College Street", with respect to Recommendations 1, 2, and 3. 2. Deleted Recommendation 1 of Item TE31.96 and replaced it with the following new Recommendation 1: "1. Toronto and East York Community Council amend the existing parking prohibition on the east side of Sheridan Avenue, between a point 42 metres north of Dundas Street West and College Street, in effect anytime from the 16th day to the last day of each month, from April 1 to November 30, inclusive, to be in effect at all times." 3. Deleted Recommendation 2 of Item TE31.96 and replace it with the following new Recommendation 2: "2.
